items.title: How Siemens Energy transformed field service operations
items.summary: Discover how Jira Service Management cut technical lead times from 62 to 21 days. Siemens Energy manufactures, sells, and supports turbines for energy generation in settings from paper mills and refineries to power stations. Each project differs in unit size, complexity, and deployment conditions, and each turbine relies on bespoke parts.
